content:
Based on the Wikipedia article on "List of longest-reigning monarchs," here are the five longest reigning monarchs in history:

## Top 5 Longest-Reigning Monarchs

| Rank | Name | Country | Reign Duration |
|------|------|---------|----------------|
| 1 | **Louis XIV** | France (and Andorra) | 72 years, 110 days (1643-1715) |
| 2 | **Elizabeth II** | United Kingdom | 70 years, 214 days (1952-2022) |
| 3 | **Rama IX** (Bhumibol Adulyadej) | Thailand | 70 years, 126 days (1946-2016) |
| 4 | **Johann II** | Liechtenstein | 70 years, 91 days (1858-1929) |
| 5 | **Kʼinich Janaabʼ Pakal I** | Palenque (modern-day Mexico) | 68 years, 33 days (615-683) |

**Key Notes:**
- **Louis XIV of France** holds the record as the longest-reigning sovereign monarch whose reign is verifiable by exact date
- **Elizabeth II** was the longest-reigning female monarch in history
- **Kʼinich Janaabʼ Pakal I** was a Mayan ruler, making this the longest reign from ancient history on the list
- This list includes monarchs of sovereign states with verifiable reigns by exact date, excluding Byzantine emperors who partly reigned as junior co-emperors
